evidence.summary: create_link() makes a token_urlsafe(16) token and stores file_id and expires_at = now + expires_in_hours (default 24) in a links dict.
Optional password stored as an unsalted SHA-256 hex digest.
open_link() raises LookupError for unknown or expired tokens, PermissionError for a wrong password, else returns file_id.
revoke_link() removes the token; no ownership check, silent if unknown.
Imports hashlib, secrets, time only (standard library).

architecture.backend: plain functions over a caller-supplied links dict

features.name: Create share link with expiry
features.description: Create an unguessable link to a file that expires after N hours.
features.observed_behaviour: Returns a 16-byte url-safe token; link expires expires_in_hours (default 24) after creation.
features.business_logic: Default expiry 24 h; expiry checked with expires_at < now.
features.integration: needs a file to exist and (in the unified app) its owner to create the link

features.name: Password-protected link
features.description: Optionally require a password to open a link.
features.observed_behaviour: Password hashed with unsalted SHA-256 at creation; compared on open.
features.business_logic: No password set means no password needed.

features.name: Open shared link
features.description: Anyone with the token opens the shared file.
features.observed_behaviour: Unknown or expired -> LookupError; wrong password -> PermissionError; otherwise returns file_id.
features.business_logic: Expired and unknown tokens are not distinguished to the caller.
features.integration: needs file download/preview for the returned file_id

features.name: Revoke share link
features.description: Remove a link so it no longer opens.
features.observed_behaviour: Token popped from the dict; no error if missing; no check of who revokes.

unknowns: Persistence: links live in a caller-supplied dict; no database schema in the source.
Who may create or revoke a link is not checked in the source (no owner concept).
